messages:
Sophie L: Nightdash alert just fired — region us-west p95 latency up ~12% since deploy 7fb3a2 (midnight roll). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/nightdash/alert/178450
Arjun P: saw it, noticing kernel-selector latency bump in the flamegraphs this morning
Maria K: flamegraph screenshot: more time in kernel_selector::score_and_pick (~2.4x). Also batch size distribution got heavier single-request tails.
Dave R: KV miss rate spiked at same time, eviction rate up 3x. maybe cache hotset shift from the merge
Sophie L: ci-bot reports nightly perf job failed on master: perf/throughput/regression job 17845 — logs attached
ci-bot: nightly-perf-job #17845 FAILED — p50+p95 throughput drop > SLO thresholds — artifacts: gs://ci-artifacts/nightly/17845/
Arjun P: can someone git-bisect? suspect commit 7fb3a2 that changed kernel affinity heuristics
Maria K: ran a quick perf profile on a replay VM: kernel selection now iterates extra fallback path when weights tie -> costly
Sophie L: command I'd run: ```git bisect start --bad 7fb3a2 --good 7e9a1c ; git bisect run ./scripts/run_perf.sh``` 
Dave R: also check kv cache TTL change in 7fb3a2? I see a one-line tweak in cache eviction policy
Arjun P: starting bisect + will pin canary to older kernel selector config to unblock rollout
Maria K: quick mitigation: bump prefetch TTL and force local-prefetch for hot keys in config, monitoring now :eyes:
Sophie L: thanks. if bisect hits 7fb3a2 we should revert or patch kernel affinity. I'll open a rollback PR if confirmed
Dave R: leaving watch on dashboard. ping @oncall if it widens
Sophie L: summary: triage -> correlated kernel-selector cost + KV hotset shift after merge 7fb3a2. Bisect in progress, temporary prefetch TTL tweak applied. Will post results.
